verdict.rationale: Okta is an identity and access management platform, not an agent or LLM host that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows only that Okta publishes its own MCP server (okta-mcp-server) and Cross App Access authorization for agents. Those are server-side and auth capabilities, so they do not make the MCP-client axis applicable and are not credited here.
